summary: Implementation plan for Enterprise Multi-Device SmartSync Hardening on Firestore: adds a persistent IndexedDB Offline Outbox Retry Queue, atomic transactional Tombstone merging, zero-read same-device BroadcastChannel multi-tab sync, zero-read Auto Drift Detection, and a compact Light Pastel Navbar Sync Control with a BaseModal Sync Center (Smart Delta Refresh & Authoritative Full Pull) while eliminating accidental stale-cache Cloud overwrites.
